topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor/editor projection for query definitions, resolved sources, filters, projections, joins, aggregations, ordering/pagination, result provenance and governance findings.

semantics.identity_rule: Query definition, query execution, source record, result set and result-field identities remain distinct.
semantics.graph_rule: Visual join edges correspond only to explicit declared relation/key joins.
semantics.action_rule: edit/save/run/materialize operations invoke separate authorized canonical workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing query definition/result metadata grants no source data authority.
semantics.derived_rule: Aggregated/projected values are visibly marked derived with provenance.
semantics.failure_rule: Ambiguous fields, unauthorized sources, invalid joins and unstable pagination are surfaced explicitly.

invariants.rule: A DWH query is an explicit read/projection definition over exact resolved schema/instance/relation identities; querying, filtering, joining, aggregating, ordering or paginating never silently changes source ownership, identity or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: monitor invents join from visual adjacency
derived aggregate shown as source truth
